cohort: 157 women with a history of GDM from Selangor, Malaysia (mean age 34.8 ± 5.6 years)
finding: Lower education level, higher pre-pregnancy BMI, and Caesarean delivery were independently associated with MetS in women with a history of GDM in Malaysia.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was independently associated with MetS in women with a history of GDM in Malaysia.
